Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

- GID (4), Rule 60 of CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021.  
The pensioner should open a Savings / Current Account in his own name (not "joint" or "either or survivor" account) if he does not have a similar  
account already.  
The pension may also be credited into a joint account operated by pensioner with his/her spouse in whose favour an authorization for family pension exists in the PPO. OM, dated 9-6-2005 and Notfn., dated 12-7-2007.
